status: three-panel 250-m stress test frozen after x-y-time-only ultrafine preflight and before any 250-m vertical output
role: post-freeze exploratory spatial-localization stress test; cannot alter v0.3.8 or generalize beyond the three structurally evaluable panels

excluded_panels.eidolon: not structurally evaluable below 500 m in prior matched preflight

ecological_question: Does centered vertical individuality persist after matching horizontal place to 250 m and broad speed×turn state in the three systems with sufficient pre-outcome support?

estimator.vertical_centering: subtract each retained session median from all retained numeric-height events before selecting valid kinematic endpoints
estimator.conditional_profile: P(centered residual height | 250-m cell, speed×turn state)
estimator.common_weighting: equal-session self distribution over jointly supported 250-m cell×state strata, applied identically to self and other vertical profiles
estimator.target_scoring: target kinematic endpoints whose 250-m cell×state stratum is supported by both predictors

calibration.permutation_unit: whole centered session block with fixed x-y-time-derived kinematic states
calibration.panel_pass_rule: exact preflight n; calibrated common 250-m-place-state identity > 0; one-sided p(null>=observed)<=0.05

decision_matrix.3_pass: All three structurally evaluable systems retain individuality at 250 m; route/resource allocation at scales >=250 m is insufficient in those systems.
decision_matrix.1_or_2_pass: Mixed ultrafine robustness; 250-m spatial allocation may explain part of the residual in some systems.
decision_matrix.0_pass: The 500-m result does not survive 250-m matching; spatial allocation below 500 m becomes a leading explanation.

synthesis.generalization_limit: No inference to P. hastatus 2023, Eidolon, or the five-panel comparison.

claim_boundary: 250-m cells are still matching strata, not exact paths/resources.
A PASS cannot rule out sub-250-m resource, corridor or microclimate structure.
This test is opened after positive 500-m results and is a stress test, not independent confirmation.
stop_rule: Do not change subset, 250-m grid, speed2_turn2 definition, centering, bins, 50-event support, expected n, B/seeds or pass criteria after output.
If any observed n differs from preflight expected n, invalidate rather than retune.
Do not open 100 m because the frozen four-panel sequential preflight stopped before that stage.
